Name: In-Game SMAPI Log Uploader
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod installed you can quickly submit a formatted SMAPI log on SMAPI.io (the first thing anyone in the modding is going ask you to do if you report a problem) from within the game itself, without relying on any external tools (besides SMAPI).

The mod provides three triggers for submitting a log:

[list]
[*]pressing a hotkey at any time (default [b]disabled[/b]).
[*]holding down a modifier key (default [b]Left Alt[/b]) and pressing the Pufferchick icon that appears in the top-left of the screen.
[*]When SMAPI detects a fatal error and the game shuts down (in cases where SMAPI doesn't catch the error, this probably won't work).
[/list]

In each of the above cases, the mod will ask your computer to open your default web browser and submit the log to SMAPI.io using a temporary HTML form.


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.
